Many Travelers would not consider the root twisted soil of a forest worth mining. Not only does the flora’s grip on the earth require 
great effort to uproot, the fauna could make short work of most exhibitions. Those brave enough to test their strength against the old 
woods would find resources unlike any other found on the island. Great stores of amber can be found beneath the oldest of the forests, 
nestled within clay beds and under generations of trees. Mossdown hangs from boughs of trees that have stood the test of time for 
centuries, bringing new life to the ancient branches with sweet fruit. And though incredibly rare, the twisted ironwood trees that lay 
low to the earth leech the irons from the soil, providing an incredibly durable material for the crafting of weapons and armor.
